The '''OT-12 Centurion Droid''' was a large, three -legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A number of OT-12 Centurion Droids were among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] defending the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] before its capture by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
